problems: kutai-kingdom merges the Cliopatria rows 'Kutai Kingdom' and 'Sultanate of Kutai Kartanegara'; se-03-a also owns sultanate-of-kutai-kartanegara with the same merge instruction and must not write a second dossier for it.

The Jambi and Kutai dossiers start earlier than Cliopatria (1460 and 1300) on page evidence; the earlier keyframes reuse or approximate the first Cliopatria shape. Bali ends 1908, one year after Cliopatria; Kutai ends 1844, one year before.

Jambi contest_end with Johor (1681, confidence 1) disagrees with the Johor dossier (October 1679); the Johor dossier's claim that no Johor-Jambi wars article exists is wrong (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johor%E2%80%93Jambi_wars).
Cliopatria artifact: the Qajar Dynasty is listed as a neighbour of Jambi and Bali in 1895-1897, and the Dutch East Indies neighbour is missing those years.

Rule-4 gaps: Jambi as a Mataram vassal (1642-1663/64), a Pagaruyung vassal (late 18th century) and a Dutch protectorate (1833/1858-1904), and Kutai as a Dutch vassal after 1844, can only be recorded from the suzerain's side; the Mataram, Pagaruyung and Dutch East Indies dossiers should carry them.

The gazetteer lacks Kutai Lama, Muara Kaman and Amlapura (used as place names, so --resolve warns); Tungkal, Tenggarong, Jembayan, Klungkung and the Batang Hari were handled with coordinates or not needed.
